use core::mem::MaybeUninit;
use tag::{Tag, TagSliceExt};

fn main() {
    let mut full = 0;
    let mut special = 0;
    let mut empty = 0;
    for value in 0..=255u8 {
        let tag = Tag(value);
        full += tag.is_full() as usize;
        special += tag.is_special() as usize;
        if tag.is_special() { empty += tag.special_is_empty() as usize; }
    }
    let mut digest = 0u64;
    for top in 0..128u64 {
        let hash = (top << 57) | 0x1234;
        let tag = Tag::full(hash);
        assert_eq!(tag.0, top as u8);
        assert!(tag.is_full());
        digest = digest.wrapping_mul(131).wrapping_add(tag.0 as u64);
    }
    let mut tags = [MaybeUninit::<Tag>::uninit(); 33];
    tags[..].fill_empty();
    for tag in tags.iter() { assert_eq!(unsafe { tag.assume_init() }, Tag::EMPTY); }
    tags[1..32].fill_tag(Tag::DELETED);
    for tag in tags[1..32].iter() { assert_eq!(unsafe { tag.assume_init() }, Tag::DELETED); }
    assert_eq!(unsafe { tags[0].assume_init() }, Tag::EMPTY);
    assert_eq!(unsafe { tags[32].assume_init() }, Tag::EMPTY);
    println!("tag {full} {special} {empty} {digest}");
    println!("{:?} {:?} {:?}", Tag::EMPTY, Tag::DELETED, Tag::full(7 << 57));
    println!("layout {} {}", core::mem::size_of::<Tag>(), core::mem::align_of::<Tag>());
}
